verdict.rationale: FreeAgent documents a direct connection for Amazon UK Marketplace, built-in payroll, and smart categorisation that automatically explains new transactions. The evidence never shows live bank feeds or payment-processor connections, and the bank transactions API only references uploaded statements. Missing for 10: documented automatic bank feed connections, payment-processor (e.g. card/online payments) integrations, connection to external payroll systems, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect my banking, payments, and payroll systems so their activity flows into the ledger automatically

citations.quote: Connect your Amazon UK Marketplace account to FreeAgent to save time and streamline your admin if you're selling online.
Run monthly payroll and file auto-calculated PAYE and National Insurance directly to HMRC.
Save time with smart categorisation which automatically explains new transactions based on previous descriptions.
